events.title: 리버풀 goalkeeper Bruce Grobbelaar leaves Anfield after 13 years to sign for 사우샘프턴 on a free transfer. The club's longest serving player Ronnie Whelan leaves Anfield on a free transfer after 15 years.
보비 찰턴 , record goalscorer for both 맨체스터 유나이티드 and England, receives a knighthood .

토트넘 홋스퍼 are found guilty of financial irregularities and receive the heaviest punishment ever imposed on an English club. The Football Association fines 토트넘 홋스퍼 £600,000, bans them from the 1994–95 FA Cup , and deducts them 12 league points from the start of next season.

With England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland all having failed to qualify for the World Cup, a mostly English based Republic of Ireland national side pull off a major shock in first group stage game of the tournament in the USA when a goal from 애스턴 빌라 winger Ray Houghton gives the Irishmen a 1-0 win over Italy in East Rutherford . The Republic are still managed by England's 1966 World Cup winning centre-half 잭 찰턴 , who has been in charge for eight years.
웨스트햄 유나이티드 sign 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 winger Joey Beauchamp for £1million.

맨체스터 시티 sign winger Nicky Summerbee from 스윈던 타운 for £1.5million. The Republic of Ireland's second World Cup group game ends in a 2-1 defeat to Mexico in Orlando , with the only goal coming from 35-year-old 트랜미어 로버스 striker John Aldridge .
The Republic of Ireland national side go through to the last 16 of the World Cup after holding Norway (also with a number of English based players) to a goalless draw in East Rutherford.
